questions.text: Explain the philosophy and teachings of Basaveshwara.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the philosophy and teachings of Basaveshwara. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Basaveshwara's reforms were:
He worked hard to build a casteless and classless society.
"Work is Worship" is his main teaching.
He condemned casteism, idol worship and sacrificial rituals and said that the body is the temple.
He gave confidence to the women by saying that they are like god & they are everything.
He established Anubhava Mandapam, a platform of Vachanakaras, at Basavakalyana.
Basaveshwara composed more than a thousand vachanas. They end with his ankitanama Kudalasangamadeva.
The message given by Sri Basaveshwara, the leader of vachana movement, for the welfare of mankind is eternal.
The Government of Karnataka on 13.2.2024 has declared Vishwaguru Basavanna as the "Cultural Leader of Karnataka".
